# Psalm 45 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. To the tune of 'Lilies.' A psalm of the descendants of Korah. A love song. A Maskil.

**2** Beautiful words stir my heart. I will recite a lovely poem about the king, for my tongue is like the pen of a skillful poet.

**3** You are the most handsome of all. Gracious words stream from Your lips. God Himself has blessed You forever.

**4** Put on Your sword, O mighty warrior! You are so glorious, so majestic!

**5** In Your majesty, ride out to victory, defending truth, humility, and justice. Go forth to perform awe-inspiring deeds!

**6** Your arrows are sharp, piercing Your enemies' hearts. The nations fall beneath Your feet.

**7** Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever. You rule with a scepter of justice.

**8** You love justice and hate evil. Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You, pouring out the oil of joy on You more than on anyone else.

**9** Your robes are perfumed with myrrh, aloes, and cassia. In ivory palaces, the music of strings entertains You.

**10** Kings' daughters are among Your noble women. At Your right hand stands the queen, wearing jewelry of finest gold from Ophir.

**11** Listen to me, O royal daughter; take to heart what I say. Forget your people and your family far away.

**12** For your royal husband delights in your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

**13** The princess of Tyre will shower you with gifts. The wealthy will beg your favor.

**14** The bride, a princess, looks glorious in her golden gown.

**15** In her beautiful robes, she is led to the king, accompanied by her bridesmaids.

**16** What a joyful and enthusiastic procession as they enter the king's palace!

**17** Your sons will become kings like their father. You will make them rulers over many lands.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **45:11**: The bride is called to 'forget' her past — a radical demand that mirrors the covenant call to leave the old identity for the new.

— PNEUMA
